findings.summary: Acid Pro is a proprietary Windows-only digital audio workstation that evolved from a loop-based music sequencer into a full-featured DAW. Its core innovation is the Acid Loop technology: audio clips pre-tagged with tempo and key information that allow automatic time-stretching and pitch-shifting without sonic degradation. The software supports MIDI, VST, VST3, DirectX audio effects, and 5.1 surround sound. Ownership has shifted among Sonic Foundry, Sony Creative Software, Magix, and most recently Boris FX. While Acid Pro includes multitrack recording and plugin support, its defining mechanism remains the tempo- and key-aware loop manipulation inherited from its 1998 origins.

mechanisms.title: Acid Loop tempo and key-aware stretching
mechanisms.explanation: Audio clips tagged with tempo and key data are automatically time-stretched and pitch-shifted to match the project's tempo and key, enabling seamless loop-based composition with minimal manual adjustment.

mechanisms.title: Plugin and format integration
mechanisms.explanation: The DAW supports MIDI, ASIO, VST, VST3, DirectX Audio, and 5.1 surround sound, allowing integration of software instruments, effects, and multichannel mixing within the project environment.
